replace:
bind_command('playlist', create_self_updating_menu_opener({
	title = t('Playlist (Type to Search)'),
	type = 'playlist',
	tabs = {{title = t('Playlist'), active = true}, {title = t('Queue'), value = 'script-message ap-queue-open'}},  -- [AnimePlayer: playlist tabs]
	tools = {
		{icon = 'done_all', title = t('Remove watched'), value = 'script-message ap-playlist-clear-watched'},  -- [AP13: remove watched]
		{icon = 'sort', title = t('Sort playlist'), value = 'script-message ap-playlist-sort-menu'},  -- [AP11: playlist sort]
		{icon = 'shuffle', title = t('Shuffle playlist'), value = 'script-message ap-playlist-shuffle'},  -- [AP7: shuffle in the playlist menu]
		{icon = 'delete_sweep', title = t('Remove all videos (keeps the playing one)'), value = 'script-message ap-playlist-clear'},  -- [AP16: clear playlist]
	},
	list_prop = 'playlist',
	extra_prop = {'user-data/ap/watched', 'user-data/ap/durations'},  -- [AP11: watched refresh] [AP17: row lengths]
	footer_prop = 'user-data/ap/playlist-footer',  -- [AP14: list totals]
	-- [AnimePlayer: queue actions] buttons that appear on the hovered row next to move up / down / remove
	actions = function(narrow)   -- [AP16: no crowding] evaluated every time the menu opens
		local list = {
			{name = 'add_queue', icon = 'playlist_add', label = t('Add to queue')},  -- [AP7: add to queue]
			{name = 'show_in_folder', icon = 'folder_special', label = t('Show in Explorer')},  -- [AP14: show in Explorer]
		}
		if not narrow then
			list[#list + 1] = {name = 'play_next', icon = 'playlist_play', label = t('Play next')}
			list[#list + 1] = {name = 'move_end', icon = 'vertical_align_bottom', label = t('Move to end')}
		end
		return list
	end,
    
    -- [SEARCH SETTINGS]
    search_style = 'palette',             -- Enables the search bar
    search_subtext = 'Type to search...', -- Adds the visual hint text
    
	footnote = t('Paste path or url to add.') .. ' ' .. t('%s to reorder.', 'ctrl+up/down/pgup/pgdn/home/end') .. ' ' .. t('Or hold a row and drag it.'),  -- [AP8: drag reorder hint]
	serializer = function(playlist)
		local items = {}
		local force_filename = mp.get_property_native('osd-playlist-entry') == 'filename'
		-- [AnimePlayer: queue as a tab] the Queue lives in its own tab next to Playlist, so playlist item n is row n again
		ap_playlist_real = {}
		local visible = {}   -- [AP15: hidden queue copy] the staged queue video is not listed
		for real_index, item in ipairs(playlist) do
			if item.current or not (item.id and ap_hidden[tostring(item.id)]) then
				visible[#visible + 1] = {real = real_index, item = item}
				ap_playlist_real[#visible] = real_index
			end
		end
		for index, entry in ipairs(visible) do
			local item = entry.item
			local title = type(item.title) == 'string' and #item.title > 0 and item.title or false
			local is_watched = (not item.current) and ap_watched[ap_norm_path(item.filename)] == true   -- [AP11: watched] finished files are greyed out
			items[index] = {
				title = (not force_filename and title) and title
					or (is_protocol(item.filename) and item.filename or serialize_path(item.filename).basename),
				hint = (ap_durs[ap_norm_path(item.filename)] and (ap_fmt_time(ap_durs[ap_norm_path(item.filename)]) .. '   ') or '') .. (is_watched and ('\226\156\147 ' .. index) or tostring(index)),
				muted = is_watched or nil,
				active = item.current,
				value = index,
			}
